request.prompt:
Goods: LED light bulb E27 9W 806lm, warm white
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 85 Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 8539: Lamps; electric filament or discharge lamps, including sealed beam lamp units and ultra-violet or infra-red lamps, arc lamps, light-emitting diode (LED) light sources
    contains 853952: Lamps; light-emitting diode (LED) light sources, light-emitting diode (LED) lamps
    contains 853951: Lamps; light-emitting diode (LED) light sources, light-emitting diode (LED) modules
    contains 853922: Lamps; filament, (excluding ultra-violet or infra-red), of a power not exceeding 200W and for a voltage exceeding 100 volts, other than tungsten halogen
- 8541: Semiconductor devices (e.g. diodes, transistors, semiconductor based transducers); including photovoltaic cells assembled or not in modules or panels, light-emitting diodes (LED) assembled with other LEDs or not, mounted piezo-electric crystals
    contains 854141: Electrical apparatus; photosensitive semiconductor devices, light emitting diodes (LED)

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: An E27-cap LED light bulb is a complete LED lamp, which heading 8539 covers (subheading 853952), rather than a bare semiconductor LED device under 8541.
